title: Fulgurite Shard
html:
Monster drop: Dune Elemental

What it’s for

An enchant reagent. Each infuse (one carat more) of one of these uses one:

  • of the Storm (gems: Onyx + Topaz + Pearl)
  • staff of Lightning (gems: Amber + Topaz + Topaz)

Dropped by Sand Elemental: Sand Elemental, Dune Elemental, Glasswrought Colossus, about 1 kill in 500 (an elite 1 in 50).

See Enchanter’s Table for the odds and fees, and Reagents for every reagent.
